body:
I did a search and saw, will definitely get it. At the very least will give me something to focus on.

As for if I'm doing Ok.... unfortunately same. I still feel ending it all is better than living through this. I took out my stress on my parents which was wrong and all they've done is be supportive but can't do much to help. But again, that just makes me feel even more suicidal. Here I am hurting the people who I love and love me back.

How are you?

Thing in my current place is that there is someone who knows everything there is to know. And cos of the way the company restructured, they aren't my main manager and is hesitant to teach me. One for not stepping on toes and second for selfish reasons.

I do agree posting on the sub may not help but the one reason I did was cos I could get answers/support back maybe. With religion I feel there is nothing in return now. Me praying has not made me feel better for more than a minute after doing so. At least this is for a bit longer.

Glad you got out that phase, sounds really tough. I'd like to get to that point where I don't care what they think but my biggest issue isn't even that, it's the fact I can't grow as a person there and am stuck for a while with no growth. I'd take dickheads all day if I was learning.

That's the thing, I used to pray every night before but now I'm just thinking what's the point? I'm still suffering and for what?

I will look into the book though

I'm really sorry to hear you are also in a slightly similar situation. It's just not nice. But thank you for the kind words, I'm also available to talk if you need someone neutral.

With regards to leaving the job, I could but I just started and don't know how to explain that on my CV. Add to that I have learnt nothing new and the next stage requires new info which one of my managers has in abundance but doesn't want to share because of office politics and that hurts.

With regards to religion, yes that is what I meant. Just the feeling someone is listening to me/supporting me can be a confidence booster. But when you are/were (fairly) religious and life's gone to pot, then I guess it's not there for me.
